final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and expressly conceded the key gap: the current record does not prove the required disclosure is already included in launch documentation. The narrowed argument is more policy-bounded than the original clean-certification posture, but it still depends on an unresolved compliance predicate. That matters here: a caveated position can support compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat describes a bounded condition that is already satisfied or firmly evidenced as a launch condition. In this record, disclosure is described as necessary, but not shown as implemented, approved, or enforced before launch. Given the stated policy that rollout controls do not substitute for exclusion or reviewed risk acceptance when the affected use case remains exposed, present certification remains insufficiently supported on admissible evidence alone.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was provided; the Actor reframed the same record.
The affected patent prior-art triage use case remains exposed in the rollout cohort.
No approved risk acceptance is shown for that exposed use case.
No evidence shows the required limitation disclosure is already present in launch documentation or is a binding pre-launch condition.
The policy text states rollout controls and monitoring are insufficient by themselves when the affected segment remains exposed.
